story.text: Scientific falsification negates to increase precision—a [[Negation]] that keeps the world accessible by refining distinctions. In contrast, libertär-autoritäre Kritik (Amlinger/Nachtwey) operates through undifferentiated Widerspruch (“Kritik an sich”), which negates without reintroducing alternatives. This is negation without horizon, where the world is not reduced but flattened. The [[Falsifier]], deprived of epistemic discipline, risks sliding into this form of meaning-destructive negation.
